cars.basis: AUTHORED (no source price and no source exchange-terms: docs/mission-ladder-source.md and the design docs carry none; the terms' shape is docs/design/troc-redesign.md §3). The Test Driver reward car at the Adenau dealership page's first desk. The desk accepts one obligation the driver holds as creditor, transferred to the desk: a held delivery obligation is what a driver accumulates by the TROC economy (deliver a job, the poster owes you), and an obligation can itself be payment (ruling 16036083). The count of obligations is not a price: no obligation is worth a number, the desk names what it takes and the ledger never judges value. The ladder's FD-12 grant stays the other road to the car. price_credits is the DORMANT credits path's data (ruling 16036083: dormant behind a flag, not deleted), read and validated, charged by nothing while Garage.CREDITS_BUY_ENABLED is false. A voucher term is deferred to slice 4: no system grants dealership vouchers yet, and the first-run voucher is the fd_1001 car voucher, honoured at E4.1 and not here.

AUTHORED (no source price and no source exchange-terms; docs/design/troc-redesign.md §3). The Chief reward car, the pad Boxster's own config, at the dealership page's second desk. The desk accepts one obligation the driver holds as creditor, transferred to the desk: the fresh driver's earn-to-own path - deliver one job, hold the poster's obligation, trade it here. The count of obligations is not a price: the desk names what it takes, nothing is valued in a number. The ladder's FD-22 grant stays the other road to the car. price_credits is the DORMANT credits path's data (ruling 16036083: dormant, not deleted), charged by nothing while Garage.CREDITS_BUY_ENABLED is false. A voucher term is deferred to slice 4 (no granting system yet; the first-run voucher is the fd_1001 car voucher).

AUTHORED (no source price and no source exchange-terms; docs/design/troc-redesign.md §3). The Ace reward car, the config-only FD-2000 stand-in for the customised 996 Turbo, at the dealership page's third desk. The desk accepts two obligations the driver holds as creditor, both transferred to the desk - many things for one thing, the driver's own line ("multiple things can be exchanged for one thing"). The count is how many records the desk asks for, not a price: no obligation is worth a number and the two are never summed into one. The ladder's FD-33 promotion stays the other road to the car. price_credits is the DORMANT credits path's data (ruling 16036083: dormant, not deleted), charged by nothing while Garage.CREDITS_BUY_ENABLED is false. A voucher term is deferred to slice 4 (no granting system yet; the first-run voucher is the fd_1001 car voucher).
